mission.title: Bon Voyage
mission.description: Meet the Effectuator and stop Zion from learning the location of one of the Merovingian's construct portals.

npc.say: Okay... I know this... just try the-- Hey!
Okay, the decryption program is loadin-- Crap! We've got incoming!
Okay, the decryption program is loadin-- Crap! We've got incoming!

phase.briefing:
I trust that flea-ridden wench has not been contacting you, has she? I wouldn't get mixed up with that sort of trash if I were you. Bad for your career, yes?
Now you must meet someone far more interesting. He is the gentleman I mentioned earlier: The Effectuator. Any travel into or out of the Merovingian's personal constructs goes through him. He does nothing but lounge around all day, drinking his frou-frou drinks and pushing papers... I'm sorry? Did you just say something? I didn't think so. Now go, do not keep him waiting!

enter.say: So, it sounds like the Effectuator is some sorta trumped up travel agent, when it comes down to it. Well, whatever he does, he's very high up in the Frenchman's hierarchy -- kind of outside of the whole structure, actually -- so if you get a chance to get on his good side, take it.

near.say: What the-- where did he come from?

talk.say:
You must be {player}. I've heard so much about you; now it is time to see if you can help me.
But no, let my friend in the next room tell you more about it.

objective.text: Talk to the Effectuator in the next room

talk.say:
So, I take it you met my friend out there? Quite a chap, eh? He reminds me of me, when I was five minutes younger... ah, youth...
Perhaps you should talk to my associate, through the next door. I'm a little choked up at the moment.

objective.text: Talk to the Effectuator's associate through the next door

talk.say: Waddya know, another one of these guys... what a joker.

Oh, {player}, please do forgive me. You see, I'm more or less broadcasting this signal... I'm not really "here" -- not that you're really "here" either though, come to think of it...
What? Oh, yes, my task. Well, you see, there are many portals hidden throughout the Matrix. I think you knew of this already. Some of those portals lead to the Merovingian's personal constructs. All good and well, but now those filthy cavemen are close to discovering one of these portals. Even as we speak they are nearing this vital information.
You must go, now, and stop them. Stop them before they learn too much!

done.say: Off to defend the portal, huh? Okay, I'm getting the coordinates now. You can get out of there.

phase.briefing: So, off to stop those pathetic Zion followers, eh? Give them a punch in the nose -- or whatever it is you do -- for me.

enter.say: All right, the Zion operatives are on site here. They've been here for some time -- hopefully they haven't turned up the information yet...

done.say: Okay, all the operatives are accounted for... you're going to have to search the active computers here and make sure they haven't been compromised.
Damn it! Looks like they've already got the data. I'm sending you to their nearest headquarters. We've got to stop them before they decrypt that data!

phase.briefing: What are you waiting for, {player}? Stop those filthy Zionites!

enter.say: The Zion operatives are in this building. I know you're up to taking them out... right?

done.say: I will not have that information falling back into enemy hands. Upload it to your operator immediately!

objective.text: Upload the Data at a hardline

mission.finish: Not bad, {player}. I'm sure I could have shown you a few little tips if I'd been there... ah, but good job, especially for you. Now scoot along, I'll handle the rest.
